text: Understanding databases is essential for anyone working with data. There are two main types: SQL and NoSQL. SQL databases store information in tables, which are organised into rows and columns. To find or change data, you write queries using a language like SQL. Good data modeling helps you plan how tables connect before you build anything. Indexes make searches faster, but they also use extra storage, so you should add them carefully. NoSQL databases, on the other hand, are more flexible and work well with large amounts of unstructured data. Choosing the right type depends on your project's needs.
